description: Land Title Settlement Department - Nuwarawewa, Nuwaragampalatha East D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110190
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land-related matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land title determination, cadastral maps, and land ownership claims in various villages of Anuradhapura District, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
